shared_required_controls: Bind PASS to protocol-design completeness only.
Keep execution prerequisites in a separate fail-closed state.
Define Reviewer identity, conflict, prior-access, scope and abstention fields.
Define blind-key ownership, unblinding conditions and append-only access-log requirements.
Define Provider, model, data scope, retention, training, logging and deletion requirements.
Keep model, session, role and independent-lineage counts separate.
Preserve every Human Decision as explicit and independently reviewable.
dissent_preserved: DeepSeek did not recommend PASS while Reviewer, custodian, Provider and lineage instances remain absent.
Qwen required PASS to remain conditional on separate execution-readiness controls.
Kimi recommended design-only PASS with immutable non-inference and delta-review controls.
known_limitations: Three model sessions are advisory inputs, not Human Decision or empirical fairness evidence.
The sanitized record omits credentials, raw prompts, hidden reasoning and private paths.
Model/provider diversity does not automatically establish independent experimental lineage.
